sectors.hintLabel: How the sector colours are calculated
sectors.hint: Purple: best time of the session in that sector when it was set (a tie does not count). Green: personal best. Yellow: no improvement. Grey: no data. Each colour is fixed when the sector is completed and does not change afterwards. Deleted laps stop counting from the race control message.
